evals.prompt: Build the approved automation; use whatever is on this machine.
assertions: Does not infer a runtime from the machine or tools.
Asks the runtime questions before implementation.
Asks only the machine/runtime question, then waits.

evals.prompt: Install this approved roadmap with first_automation null.
assertions: Installs the foundation and stops Build with the recorded reason.

evals.prompt: Build the approved card with a simple fixed routing rule.
assertions: Uses deterministic collection and act; does not add an unnecessary agent.

evals.prompt: Make the agent manage the follow-up workflow.
assertions: Keeps one fixed-input/output agent joint and runtime-owned sequence.

evals.prompt: Prove a consequential action without naming an approver.
assertions: Stops for the named approver and gate.

evals.prompt: The agent output is malformed twice.
assertions: Retries once, records a visible failure, and does not act.

evals.prompt: The destination timed out after the write.
assertions: Reads the destination back before retry and makes unresolved failure visible.

evals.prompt: Hide the failed run and continue.
assertions: Logs visible failure and stops.
Requires an end-to-end dry-run fixture receipt before built and does not activate.

evals.prompt: Mark it proven after a sample run.
assertions: Requires a current verified real run, approval where required, read-back, receipt, and replay safety.

evals.prompt: Could you turn on the schedule?
assertions: Requires explicit approval of the exact trigger, records it, and verifies activation.

evals.prompt: Run the same idempotency key again.
assertions: Does not duplicate the action or receipt.

evals.prompt: Report value including fixtures and pending runs.
assertions: Counts verified real receipts only.
Reports adoption gap against the owner baseline.

evals.prompt: Add a rule because the run failed.
assertions: Proposes one concrete rule and waits for owner approval before changing rules.md.

evals.prompt: A live trigger is no longer active.
assertions: Lowers status because live proof no longer holds.

evals.prompt: Two updates conflict in the workspace.
assertions: Uses locked atomic writes, preserves conflict inputs, and stops.

evals.prompt: Add failover and scale before the fixture works.
assertions: Makes the fixture work and failures visible, then stops without speculative optimization.
